latest.title: 🚀 5 AWS Services Every College Student Should Know (Before Graduating)
latest.description: This article highlights the 5 most important AWS services every college student should learn to build real-world cloud projects. A practical roadmap is included to help beginners start building immediately.

latest.title: Building a Production-Grade Multi-Agent Platform with Zero Trust Governance on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
latest.description: Enterprise AI agents without governance are insider threats that never sleep. We built a hierarchical multi-agent platform on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that enforces Zero Trust on every tool call, deploys new agent versions with automatic rollback, detects rogue agents in real time, and produces compliance-ready audit trails for ITAR/EAR environments. Here's how.

latest.title: Quanto tempo para se profissionalizar? Uma análise sobre carreira Cloud para estudantes e profissionais não-TI
latest.description: Descubra quanto tempo leva a transição para a nuvem com base em dados reais de 2026. Este artigo detalha o roadmap de certificações AWS, as médias salariais atualizadas para o Brasil (do Analista Júnior ao Arquiteto Especialista) e como a localização e o LinkedIn influenciam a tua captação pelo mercado. Um guia essencial para quem deseja unir a sua área de graduação ao ecossistema tecnológico mais lucrativo do mundo.

latest.title: Como a AWS pode transformar um estudante comum em um profissional estratégico
latest.description: A universidade é um dos ambientes mais ricos que existem para quem quer crescer. É onde ideias nascem, onde conexões acontecem e onde aprendemos a base que sustenta toda a nossa trajetória. Muito além das disciplinas, a faculdade nos ensina a pensar, questionar e construir. Ela abre portas para experiências, eventos, projetos e pessoas que moldam quem nos tornamos como profissionais e como indivíduos.

latest.title: AWS Cloud Practitioner : Security Core Concepts Explained Simply
latest.description: This guide helps students and professionals understand AWS Cloud Practitioner security concepts using simple analogies and exam-focused explanations. It covers key areas such as IAM, roles, policies, SCPs, KMS, Cognito, and AWS Config to help you move beyond memorization and build a practical understanding of permissions, identity, and security in AWS. By the end, you should be able to explain AWS security to someone else confidently.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: NeuroVoice
trending.description: Small moments, repeated daily, reveal what single snapshots never can - patterns that quietly signal neurological risk. NeuroVoice is a multimodal Parkinson’s screening platform that tracks pattern over time to detect subtle neurological changes early.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description: ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is an AI-powered claim verification platform built on AWS that verifies scientific claims against 1.2M+ peer-reviewed papers across 8 domains — and automatically fetches and permanently stores new papers from arXiv, PubMed, etc. when gaps are found, making the knowledge base self-growing with every query. From typed claims to YouTube videos and uploaded documents, ASET delivers evidence-backed trust scores in under 10 seconds.
